args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks immediately after deploy to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Per runbook, rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0 — the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback is verified and rolled_out. v2.3.1 is quarantined pending investigation; a fix or revert commit is required before any re-deploy attempt.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Here's what happened:

**Diagnosis:**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an **18% error rate**.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release with a **healthy** production status (v2.3.1 and the v2.3.1-rc staging run were both unhealthy).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0** — the rollback is verified, all regions now report v2.3.0.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident `INC-0001`** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions") with a summary of the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged. I used an idempotency key so it can't be accidentally duplicated.

**Note:** v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so any attempt to re-deploy or patch-forward it will require change-manager approval before it can proceed.
